question: What happens if I miss a final expense premium payment?
answer: If you miss a premium payment, most life policies have a grace period (often about 30 days, depending on the contract) before the policy can lapse. Contact the carrier or Julie as soon as possible — options may include paying the past-due premium, adjusting the payment method, or reviewing whether the face amount still fits your budget. Do not assume coverage continues after a lapse.

question: Final expense vs prepaid funeral — which is better?
answer: Final expense whole life pays a cash benefit to your beneficiary, who can use it for funeral costs or other needs. A prepaid funeral usually locks services to a specific funeral home and package. Final expense often offers more flexibility if you move or your wishes change; prepaid can work if you want a specific funeral home package locked in. Compare both carefully before signing.

question: ¿Gastos finales o funeral prepagado — qué conviene más?
answer: El seguro de gastos finales paga un beneficio en efectivo a su beneficiario, quien puede usarlo para el funeral u otras necesidades. Un funeral prepagado suele amarrar servicios a una funeraria y un paquete concretos. Los gastos finales suelen dar más flexibilidad si se muda o cambian los deseos; el prepagado puede servir si quiere fijar un paquete en una funeraria. Compare ambos con calma antes de firmar.
